message.content: No, Hailey did not mention the new high-protein breads to Li Hua prior to inviting her to the special bakery event. The invitation was specifically for a tasting session of a new line of healthy bread options, which included samples and a workshop. The announcement about the new high-protein breads came later, during a conversation between Li Hua and ChaeSong-hwa about healthy eating and recipes. This dialogue took place after the initial invitation to the event.
